title:
Fix crosslink #275 (HIGH, anti-Goodhart soundness hole): the solver-vacuity checks silently no-op on every struct/enum-returning fn. ENVIRONMENT (use this directly — do NOT read any file outside the repo, do NOT probe; that stalls on a permission prompt): the Verus binary is at /Users/maxine/verus-dist/verus-arm64-macos/verus — for the gauntlet run: export VERUS_BIN=/Users/maxine/verus-dist/verus-arm64-macos/verus and add its directory to PATH; lake is at /Users/maxine/.elan/bin (add to PATH). New verus/lake tests must use the EXISTING verus_present()/lake_present() skip-guard helpers (they check PATH/env, not any external file).

THE BUG (two coupled defects in forge/src/vacuity_solver.rs): (1) extract_lowered_fn (~line 311) builds the tautology/vacuous-precondition harness sub-program from spec_items + the target fn but does NOT weave in the reachable struct/enum (ADT) declarations the fn's params/result/body reference, so an ADT-returning or ADT-taking fn's harness fails to COMPILE with E0425 'cannot find type/value'. (2) interpret_summary (~line 595) maps a summary of success:false / errors:0 to HarnessOutcome::Failed, which the vacuity logic reads as a CLEAN pass — so the E0425 compile error reads as 'not a tautology / not vacuous' and BOTH checks silently no-op. Net: every ADT-returning fn (the editor example) bypasses both anti-Goodhart vacuity checks — an R-CODE-4 'non-verdict read as clean' violation.

Follow the ACToR read-write-verify-commit loop; commit per coherent sub-unit; self-verify before each commit; revert anything that fails. STANDING SELF-VERIFY: run python3 tooling/doc-drift.py and RE-PIN the audited-sha of EVERY design doc whose governed source you touch; run req-registry.py --check; finish 0-drift.

SCOPE: the #275 fix ONLY (NOT #271 spec-tightness). Two parts:
1. WEAVE ADT DEPS: extend the harness sub-program construction to include the struct/enum definitions reachable from the target fn's signature + body — mirror however reachable SPEC-FN deps are already woven (there is likely an existing reachable-deps closure for spec fns; extend it to ADTs or add a reachable_adt_deps pass). An ADT-returning fn's harness must now COMPILE.
2. SEPARATE COMPILE-ERROR FROM VERIFICATION-FAILED: a harness that fails to COMPILE/elaborate (E0425, unresolved name, parse/VIR error) is a HARNESS CONSTRUCTION error → a loud ForgeError, NEVER HarnessOutcome::Failed→Clean. Only a genuine verus 'failed' (harness compiled, obligation checked-and-not-proved) is the Failed/Clean signal. Preserve the existing inverted-verdict logic (tautology: empty-body harness PROVES → reject; vacuous req: assert(false) PROVES → reject).

TESTS (verus_present-guarded): an ADT-returning fn with a body-ignoring/tautological ens is now REJECTED as a tautology (not silently clean); a vacuous-precondition ADT-taking fn is rejected; an unconstructable harness surfaces a ForgeError, never a clean verdict. The pre-existing scalar path stays byte-unchanged (existing vacuity conformance certs byte-identical).

GAUNTLET before each commit: cargo test -p forge (with VERUS_BIN set as above); clippy -p forge --all-targets -- -D warnings; fmt --check; doc-drift 0-drift; req-registry --check clean; conformance oracle byte-identical. No stubs/TODOs.

SCOPE GUARDS: no cage change; do NOT flip the README headline; never stage .crosslink/hook-config.json or .claude/settings.json. NOTE: git push is blocked for you — commit locally, end with a clear summary, the orchestrator pushes + opens the PR. One branch; ONE fix (#275).
